name: home-708
description: Production 3D digital twin and interior layout editor

scripts.build:design-review: node scripts/build-house-design-review.mjs && node scripts/build-room-design-book.mjs && node scripts/build-design-library.mjs
scripts.build:stone-linen: node scripts/build-stone-linen.mjs && node scripts/build-house-design-review.mjs stone-linen && node scripts/build-room-design-book.mjs stone-linen && node scripts/build-design-library.mjs
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @city-home/web" "npm run dev -w @city-home/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @city-home/shared && npm run build -w @city-home/scene && npm run build -w @city-home/web && npm run build -w @city-home/server
scripts.build:cloudflare: npm run build -w @city-home/shared && npm run build -w @city-home/scene && npm run build -w @city-home/web
scripts.preview:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler pages dev apps/web/dist
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name home-708 --branch main
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @city-home/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:interior-guide: node scripts/build-interior-design-guide.mjs && node scripts/build-house-design-review.mjs && node scripts/build-room-design-book.mjs && node scripts/build-design-library.mjs
scripts.build:rh-consultation: node scripts/prepare-rh-house-consultation.mjs && node scripts/sync-rh-furniture-generations.mjs && python3 scripts/build-rh-house-consultation.py
